title: Understanding Automated Program Repair Agents Through the Lens of Traceability: An Empirical Study
abstract: arXiv:2506.08311v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Automated Program Repair (APR) agents leverage large language models (LLMs) to autonomously diagnose and patch software bugs using planning, reasoning, and tools. Although these agents show strong performance on leaderboards such as SWE-bench, little is understood about how they take actions, where they fail, and how their behavior compares to human developers. In this paper, we present the first systematic analysis of these limitations using 5 state-of-the-art APR agents. We trace the full decision-making pipelines of the 5 APR agents across 500 real-world repair tasks, from issue description to patch validation. Our study reveals that, while agents excel at simple fixes, they struggle with logic-intensive bugs, often generating verbose, overfitted patches that pass existing test suites without solving the root cause. translated_title: 通过可追溯性视角理解自动程序修复智能体：一项实证研究
translated_abstract: 自动程序修复（APR）智能体利用大语言模型（LLM），通过规划、推理和工具来自主诊断并修补软件缺陷。尽管这些智能体在SWE-bench等排行榜上表现出色，但人们对它们如何采取行动、在哪些环节失败，以及其行为与人类开发者的差异知之甚少。在本文中，我们使用5个最先进的APR智能体，首次对这些局限性进行了系统性分析。我们追踪了这5个APR智能体在500个真实世界修复任务中的完整决策流程，从问题描述到补丁验证。我们的研究表明，虽然智能体擅长简单的修复，但它们在处理逻辑密集型缺陷时表现不佳，常常生成冗长且过拟合的补丁，这些补丁虽然能通过现有测试套件，却并未解决根本原因。测试生成和回归测试选择仍然是主要瓶颈，因为智能体无法复现问题或……
tldr: 本文首次系统性地追踪了5个最先进的自动程序修复智能体在500个真实修复任务中的完整决策流程，揭示了它们虽擅长简单修复，但难以处理逻辑密集型缺陷、常生成无法解决根本原因的过拟合补丁，且测试生成与回归测试选择仍是主要瓶颈。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first systematic analysis of 5 state-of-the-art APR agents by tracing their full decision-making pipelines across 500 real-world repair tasks, revealing that while they excel at simple fixes, they struggle with logic-intensive bugs, generate overfitted patches that pass existing tests without addressing root causes, and face major bottlenecks in test generation and regression test selection.
